description: Compute the CY2026 statutory mortgage limit for a unit mix: table amount per bedroom count (elevator or not) times the high cost percentage (270% standard for 2026, up to 315% project by project in High Cost Areas, 405% in Alaska, Hawaii, Guam and USVI). Also reports the ROAD to Housing Act base amounts, which are enacted but pending HUD implementation.
name: statutory_limit
title: HUD statutory per-unit limit for a unit mix
